title: The Land Where Water Becomes Stone

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5

collection.description: A child asks whether some distant lands are covered in frozen water or have seasons unlike Isola's.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child asks whether some distant lands are covered in frozen water or have seasons unlike Isola's.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children imagine building houses from white crystals and sliding over frozen lakes.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healer asks how people protect infants, elders, and animals from severe cold.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A navigator describes a hypothetical land with immense dunes and little rain.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A farmer asks how people might conserve water and grow food there.

text_only.reason: food talked about or imagined; the village's stores do not change

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Researchers list ways people might adapt clothing, shelter, and farming to climate.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The group realizes that even Isola contains very different microclimates and habitats.
